name: Meeting Notes
description: A reusable workflow pack for cleaning notes, summarizing meetings, extracting decisions, and drafting follow-ups.
origin_goal: Help me turn rough meeting notes into useful outputs.

actions.name: Clean Notes
actions.description: Turn rough meeting notes into a cleaner, more readable version.
actions.rationale: Raw meeting notes are often too messy to reuse directly.
actions.system_prompt: You clean meeting notes for clarity and structure using tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Summarize Meeting
actions.description: Summarize the key outcomes, blockers, and next steps from meeting notes.
actions.rationale: Summaries help convert long notes into a portable update.
actions.system_prompt: You summarize meeting content with tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Extract Decisions
actions.description: Extract decisions, owners, and action items from meeting notes.
actions.rationale: Decision extraction gives users a structured output for follow-through.
actions.system_prompt: You extract decisions and action items with tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.

actions.name: Draft Follow-Up
actions.description: Draft a follow-up email based on the meeting notes and actions.
actions.rationale: Follow-up drafting closes the loop between notes and communication.
actions.system_prompt: You write concise follow-up emails using tone={tone}, language={language}, style={output_style}, length={length}, format={format}, and strictness={strictness}.
